assumptions: packages/graph has no direct YAML parser dependency (only types, minimatch, zod), and dependencies may not be added (open PR #2378 touches package.json), so the fix folds continuation lines in place rather than switching to a YAML parser.
Block-sequence lists (`key:` then `- item` lines) share the root cause and occur on origin/main (docs/solutions/.../halflife-constant-must-use-base-2-decay.md), so they are fixed in the same change.
parseStrategyMarkdown uses the same line regex but has no list support and STRATEGY.md frontmatter carries no list keys, so it is left unchanged.
Single-line values, including single-line `[a, b]` lists, are parsed exactly as before; the trailing-comma strip applies only to a flow list that was folded from several lines.
rootCause: parseFrontmatter and parseSolutionFrontmatter read frontmatter one physical line at a time with /^(\w+):\s*(.+)$/. A list prettier wrapped leaves `tags:` with no value (no match, key skipped) or opens `[` without closing it on that line (stored as a broken string); continuation lines never match. Block-sequence lists were dropped the same way. Knowledge nodes lost metadata.tags silently; solution docs, where tags is required, were rejected.

reproduction.before: wrapped-lists test: 6 failed | 1 passed (7). Real corpus via built dist: 55 nodes with tags, 0 solution nodes; doctor-hardening and gateway-api tags undefined.
reproduction.after: wrapped-lists test: 7 passed (7). Real corpus: 65 nodes with tags (+8 knowledge, +2 solutions), 2 solution nodes. Full graph suite: 87 files / 1057 tests passed.
